item.title: Marella has never called at an Albanian port with an adults-only ship. That changes in May 2027. 🌍
item.description:
Marella has never called at an Albanian port with an adults-only ship. That changes in May 2027. 🌍
Discovery 2's new Ionian Shores itinerary adds a first-ever stop at Sarandë, Albania, alongside Syracuse in Sicily. For clients who have done Dubrovnik and Kotor and want somewhere genuinely new on the map, this is the one. Couples, honeymooners, adults-only seekers. From £1,930pp, departing from 6 May 2027.
One to add to our radar this week: Marella's Cruise Month runs through September, and the 2027 programme is open for booking now. ✈️

item.title: A Michelin-listed restaurant, a spa the size of a small hotel, and 593 all-suite rooms pitched squarely at couples who've done the busy Cancún strip once and want something quieter this time. 🌍
item.description:
A Michelin-listed restaurant, a spa the size of a small hotel, and 593 all-suite rooms pitched squarely at couples who've done the busy Cancún strip once and want something quieter this time. 🌍
ATELIER Playa Mujeres sits north of Cancún on the Caribbean coast, adults-only, all-inclusive, and genuinely art-led. Rate access comes through Stuba, so margin stays with you.
The booking hook this week: save up to 45% on selected stays through to June 2027 for bookings made before 6 October. ⭐

item.title: The client for this one is the person who has had both Petra and the Pyramids on the list for years but never made it to either. 🌍
item.description:
The client for this one is the person who has had both Petra and the Pyramids on the list for years but never made it to either. 🌍
A nine-night Wonky Sheep Travel small-group tour in May 2027 covers both countries in one route. The Wadi Rum stop stands out... a jeep tour into the desert for sunset, dinner, then a full overnight at camp with private bathrooms. That is not something you usually find on these itineraries.
Petra, Little Petra, the Dead Sea, Saqqara, and the new Grand Egyptian Museum are all included too, with flights from £2,439pp. ✈️

item.description:
A Carnaval parade on arrival, a full beach day on some of the softest sand in the Grenadines, then a beachside soirée with BBQ, cocktails and live music as the light fades. 🌊 That is the Canouan shore day Silversea has built into select 2026/27 Caribbean sailings... and it is a day you can describe to a client by the hour.
The structure is the selling point. For honeymooners, milestone couples and clients who have already done the standard Caribbean, this gives you a shore story with a beginning, middle and end rather than "a beach day".
Worth flagging now: the savings window on these sailings closes 8 September. ⏳ Anyone currently weighing a luxury Caribbean cruise for 2026/27 is exactly who this window is for.

item.title: One for the luxury specialists… and the family market, and couples. Ikos Dassia on Corfu is one of those rare properties that covers all three enquiry types from a single page in your brochure.
item.description:
One for the luxury specialists… and the family market, and couples. Ikos Dassia on Corfu is one of those rare properties that covers all three enquiry types from a single page in your brochure.
Here is why it is worth your attention right now: there is a reduced minimum-stay requirement across late-summer 2026 dates, and it came through the trade before it went public. 🌍 That window is open now.
Nine restaurants with Michelin-starred menus, Dine Out access to genuine local Corfiot tavernas at no extra cost, and a spa by Anne Semonin Paris included in the stay. For UK families, the Heroes Crèche and Kids Club are staffed to Ofsted standards… a trust signal British parents recognise straight away.
The advice from Janine: contact the supplier this week to confirm the exact late-summer dates before they open publicly. 📅

item.title: One for the nature-luxury specialists… Costa Rica is a destination worth having on the shortlist right now, and this week's supplier material from Exsus Travel gave us something genuinely useful.
item.description:
One for the nature-luxury specialists… Costa Rica is a destination worth having on the shortlist right now, and this week's supplier material from Exsus Travel gave us something genuinely useful.
They put together an 8-night Arenal and Monteverde itinerary from £5,675pp, with named lodges, a real sample itinerary, and specifics you can quote today. 🌿 Nayara Gardens in Arenal has private hot tubs and volcano views. Monteverde Lodge & Gardens puts guests inside the cloud forest, no TVs by design.
The transfer between the two is worth knowing. A 4WD drive down to Lake Arenal, then 30 minutes by boat across the water. 🚤 That detail alone moves a client from curious to committed.
